verdict.rationale: Heap's homepage markets Sense Chat as a chat-based way for anyone to get to analytics insights without a learning curve, which implies a first-party conversational interface. That is only a single thin marketing line, with no description of supported commands or scope. missing for 10: documentation of what Sense Chat can do via natural language (building charts, defining events, configuring the product beyond answering questions), evidence that it operates the product rather than just answering queries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
